verdict.rationale: Greptile documents a review summary on each PR, with a confidence score and short verdict at the top and a severity-sorted findings list. It also generates sequence diagrams and flowcharts for every PR to help reviewers parse complex changes, which partly serves orientation. However, the summary is findings-oriented, and no documented prose description of what the PR changes or file-by-file walkthrough appears. Missing for 10: explicit auto-generated PR change summary/description, file-by-file change walkthrough, independent or hands-on corroboration of summary quality.

support.subject: As a developer, every PR gets an auto-generated summary and change walkthrough so human reviewers orient fast

citations.quote: Confidence score and a short verdict at the top. A Findings list sorted by severity, with links to each comment.
Parse complex changes with sequence diagrams and flowcharts generated for every PR
A Fix All button in the review summary sends every issue at once.
Know how safe a PR is to merge at a glance with a 0-5 score
